name: Buried Alive

targets.description: a creature you can see that is standing on the ground

params.auto_success: any floor indoors (stone, metal or boards)

summary: Str save or the ground swallows the target 10 ft down: Total Cover, Restrained, Blinded, can't breathe; a DC 15 Athletics check as an action digs it out in 5-ft steps.
text: A creature you can see within 60 feet that is standing on the ground makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure the ground opens and swallows it, burying it up to 10 feet deep. While buried the target has Total Cover, the Restrained and Blinded conditions, and cannot breathe. On a success the target is knocked Prone and its Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn. A buried creature can dig itself out by using its action to make a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check: on a success it digs 5 feet closer to the surface, and if it succeeds by 5 or more it reaches the surface at once. A creature reaching the surface comes out Prone. The target automatically succeeds on the save if it stands on any thickness of stone or metal, or on at least 2 inches of wood.
